# supervisor-pydantic

> Pydantic models and lifecycle tools for supervisord

## Pages

- [supervisor-pydantic](index.html.md): Typed, YAML-friendly models and lifecycle tools for supervisord.
- [Tutorial: render a supervisord configuration](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): In this tutorial, we will model one worker process, render its supervisord configuration, and write the files to a temporary directory.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): These guides cover configuration loading, process control, and integrations.
- [Why the convenience layer exists](docs/src/explanation.html.md): SupervisorConfiguration mirrors supervisord’s native configuration structure. It is appropriate when every section and directive should be selected directly....
